title: Independent audit: exhaustive full-query support hypotheses
body:
Independent exhaustive finite-field checks cover 118,944 full-query cases, with a rational sharp example and explicit controls for missing rank and invertibility hypotheses.

This is a deliberately independent audit of [PR1877](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1877) at 4d9fa6016682c910be06e55b1c974d53052aee76. The precise mathematical domain, separately implemented method, failure controls, exact source pins, predecessor credit and open next question are in research/source-query-finite-field-audit/README.md. The predecessor result is credited; no defect or new original theorem is implied.

Validation: Python3.12 registered replay and metadata/source checks pass; Python3.14 optimized replay produces the identical exact receipt; modified source and receipt controls reject; selected-record integrity and whitespace checks pass. No full cold/native/hosting/all-size replay or new kappa is claimed. Only this new package changes.

Reproduce: python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/source-query-finite-field-audit.

Prepared for woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0; no independent human or formal proof-assistant review. Base 0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea. Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1163#discussioncomment-18924424.

Final source refresh: PR1877 advanced to `6d455d2d71eb35ecf8e562711e5f719b994fe3f3`; the audited algebraic theorem section is byte-identical. `SOURCE-REFRESH.json` records exact before/after file hashes. New actual 112-port sharpness and frame extensions are credited but remain outside this finite-field audit; original immutable source pins are retained.
